decisions.reason: The encrypted second channel is central to the firm's secure-ecosystem strategy, its prospects are still uncertain only one year after launch, and keeping it costs little.
Mobile PDF signing fits the firm's push into online contract signing, and as a low-cost feature close to the core offer it is worth keeping open while demand clarifies.
The multi-layer end-to-end architecture is a platform-level element that underpins the other offers, so dropping it would forgo many follow-on options.
The email-to-app delivery robot is a niche extension with uncertain uptake, but its incremental cost is low and its value is not yet revealed, so the option stays open.
The QR hardware token carries higher hardware costs and faces app-based substitutes, but regulatory demand for strong customer authentication under PSD2 in 2019 makes it premature to abandon.
The payment network compliance suite addresses ongoing regulatory requirements in payments, so its value is plausible and still unresolved, which justifies keeping it.
